author: Connor Creates
description:
I still have nightmares about those alligators...

this was one of my most ambitious projects yet. It took 30+ hours of travel, lots of learning, prayers, hard work, sun burn and fun. Such an epic quest that I'm really grateful to have done. These Megalodon shark teeth are legit my new prized possessions! 

Jim's channel: https://www.youtube.com/@thewildgame1
Chris and Fossil Recovery: https://fossilrecoveryexploration.com/

Come say hi on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/connorcreates/
And subscribe here on YT: youtube.com/@itsConnorCreates

thanks for watching this video! I really appreciate you taking the time to watch it, and your support means a lot! This is my dream job and it wouldn't be possible without you. SO THANKS AND HAVE A GREAT DAY! :)
title: I Hunted for Giant Shark Teeth with No Experience
